leads_today_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE keywords!='' AND date(timestamp)=date('now', 'localtime')

leads_yesterday_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE keywords!='' AND date(timestamp)=date('now', 'localtime', '-1 day')

leads_week_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE keywords!='' AND timestamp >= datetime('now', 'localtime', '-7 days')

leads_month_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE keywords!='' AND timestamp >= datetime('now', 'localtime', '-30 days')

leads_24h_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE keywords!='' AND timestamp >= datetime('now', 'localtime', '-1 day')

leads_total_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE keywords!=''

hot_today_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE keywords!='' AND opportunity_type='داغ' AND date(timestamp)=date('now', 'localtime')
hot_today_count.description: تعداد سرنخ داغ امروز (به وقت محلی)

hot_total_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE keywords!='' AND opportunity_type='داغ'
